files.description: Parcel price table (120 rows, sorted by weight_kg, each weight once): weight_kg (two decimals, from 0.40 to 54.05, never a whole number), zones (whole number 1-5), fee (two decimals; about 4% empty).

task_text: What is the average fee for parcels weighing from 5 kg up to 15 kg (empty fees ignored)? `result` should be that number.
intended_computation: Mean of the non-empty fees of the 22 rows with 5 <= weight_kg <= 15.

predicted_direction.reason: The integer slice on the weight index meant weights 5-15 on 2.x; on 3.x it is positions 5-14, so other parcels are averaged.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row I02; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
